title: Effectivity of a coproduct epimorphism tested on the two complementary subtopoi X/U and X/U
statement_scope: Full Lemma 5.4: for an infinity-topos X containing a (-1)-truncated object U, with i_*: X -> X/U and j_*: X -> X/U the associated geometric morphisms, a family of morphisms {alpha_i : X_i -> X} has the property that the composite coproduct map is an effective epimorphism if and only if both induced maps of coproducts are effective epimorphisms in X/U and X/U respectively; all hypotheses, quantifiers and the biconditional conclusion are counted.
